summary: Himalaya Shipping Ltd., a Bermuda-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release that invites investors to a conference call to discuss its second-quarter 2026 financial results. The release provides dial-in details, a registration link, and notes the earnings report will be available on the company's website. This is a routine earnings-announcement notice with no special-situation elements such as mergers, tender offers, or strategic actions. The filing contains no deal terms, no advisor mentions, and no unusual corporate activity.
